No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we going to the zoo today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə zu təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們今天要去動物園嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I booked the tickets last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ bʊkt ðə ˈtɪkəts læst naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，我昨晚訂好票了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you buy tickets online?
dialogue.zh: 你在線上買票了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we can scan them at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi kæn skæn ðɛm æt ðə ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 買了，進門掃碼就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are single-day tickets enough for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ˈsɪŋɡəl deɪ ˈtɪkəts ɪˈnʌf fər ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 一日票對我們來說夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but an annual pass is cheaper.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bət ən ˈænjuəl pæs ɪz ˈtʃipər./
dialogue.zh: 夠，不過年卡比較便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the annual pass?
dialogue.zh: 年卡多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It costs one hundred dollars a year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kɔsts wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈdɑlərz ə jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 一年一百美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the pass include parking?
dialogue.zh: 年卡包含停車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, parking is free for pass holders.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈpɑrkɪŋ ɪz fri fər pæs ˈhoʊldərz./
dialogue.zh: 包含，持卡停車免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we visit as often as we want?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi ˈvɪzɪt æz ˈɔfən æz wi wɑnt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們想來就可以來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the pass lets us come any day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə pæs lɛts ʌs kʌm ˈɛni deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，哪天都能進園。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I buy the pass today?
dialogue.zh: 我今天要買年卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's ask at the gate first.
dialogue.zh: 我們先在門口問問看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does the zoo open?
dialogue.zh: 動物園幾點開門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It opens at nine in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊpənz æt naɪn ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 早上九點開園。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should leave before eight thirty.
dialogue.zh: 我們八點半前得出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wake the kids right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl weɪk ðə kɪdz raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我這就去叫孩子們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the backpack packed with snacks?
dialogue.zh: 背包裡裝點心了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, crackers and little juice boxes.
dialogue.zh: 裝了，有餅乾和小果汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you pack a hat for Sam?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju pæk ə hæt fər sæm?/
dialogue.zh: 你有幫山姆帶帽子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, his yellow hat is in the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hɪz ˈjɛloʊ hæt ɪz ɪn ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 有，他的黃帽子在袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It will be hot and sunny.
dialogue.zh: 今天會又熱又晴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will add sunscreen to the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æd ˈsʌnˌskrin tu ðə lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 我把防曬乳加進清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have enough water bottles?
dialogue.zh: 我們的水瓶夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two big bottles, plus the kids' cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bɪɡ ˈbɑtəlz, plʌs ðə kɪdz kʌps./
dialogue.zh: 兩瓶大的，再加孩子們的水杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you fill his little cup?
dialogue.zh: 你能幫他的小壺裝水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will fill it now.
dialogue.zh: 當然，我馬上裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the stroller still clean?
dialogue.zh: 推車還乾淨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, I wiped the seat last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst, aɪ waɪpt ðə sit læst naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，我昨晚擦過座椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need the stroller for Lily.
dialogue.zh: 莉莉需要坐推車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she gets tired so fast.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，她一下子就累。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you fold the small blanket?
dialogue.zh: 小毯子摺好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on top of the stroller.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɑn tɑp əv ðə ˈstrɑlər./
dialogue.zh: 放在推車最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not forget my sunglasses.
dialogue.zh: 別忘了我的太陽眼鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are in the kitchen drawer.
dialogue.zh: 在廚房的抽屜裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you bring wet wipes?
dialogue.zh: 濕紙巾帶來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two packs are in the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tu pæks ər ɪn ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 有，兩包都在袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should take some band-aids.
dialogue.zh: 我們該帶些OK繃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, and some bug spray too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, ænd səm bʌɡ spreɪ tu./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，還得帶防蚊噴霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need an umbrella?
dialogue.zh: 我們需要帶傘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sky is clear, no rain today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skaɪ ɪz klɪr, noʊ reɪn təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 天空很清，今天不下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the kids dressed and ready?
dialogue.zh: 孩子們穿好準備了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam is still looking for his shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm ɪz stɪl ˈlʊkɪŋ fər hɪz ʃuz./
dialogue.zh: 山姆還在找他的鞋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell him to hurry up, please.
dialogue.zh: 請催他快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says one shoe is missing.
dialogue.zh: 他說少了一隻鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His old pair is by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz oʊld pɛr ɪz baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 他的舊鞋就在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, put them on his feet.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，幫他穿上吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which car are we taking today?
dialogue.zh: 我們今天開哪台車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our small one, the trunk is big enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər smɔl wʌn, ðə trʌŋk ɪz bɪɡ ɪˈnʌf./
dialogue.zh: 開我們的小車，後車廂夠大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the baby seat in the back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈbeɪbi sit ɪn ðə bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 安全座椅在後面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Lily is buckled in already.
dialogue.zh: 在，莉莉已經繫好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start the car, we are late.
dialogue.zh: 發車吧，我們要遲到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am driving, you hold the map.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈdraɪvɪŋ, ju hoʊld ðə mæp./
dialogue.zh: 我來開車，你拿地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the zoo parking lot big?
dialogue.zh: 動物園的停車場大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but it fills up fast on weekends.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bət ɪt fɪlz ʌp fæst ɑn ˈwikˌɛnds./
dialogue.zh: 大，但週末很快就滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we park near the main gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi pɑrk nɪr ðə meɪn ɡeɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要停在大門附近嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first lot is usually full.
dialogue.zh: 第一個停車場常常滿位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a second lot by the hill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈsɛkənd lɑt baɪ ðə hɪl./
dialogue.zh: 山邊還有第二個停車場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one has a free shuttle bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn hæz ə fri ˈʃʌtl bʌs./
dialogue.zh: 那裡有免費的擺渡車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How often does the shuttle run?
dialogue.zh: 擺渡車多久一班？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every ten minutes, all day long.
dialogue.zh: 全天每十分鐘一班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we pay for the shuttle?
dialogue.zh: 搭擺渡車要錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is free with your ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt ɪz fri wɪð jʊr ˈtɪkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不用，持門票免費搭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the shuttle stop by the trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ðə ˈʃʌtl stɑp baɪ ðə triz./
dialogue.zh: 樹那邊就是擺渡車站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus is turning in already.
dialogue.zh: 車已經轉進來了呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this bus going to the zoo?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs bʌs ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə zu?/
dialogue.zh: 這班車是去動物園的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hop on, four seats are free.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hɑp ɑn, fɔr sits ər fri./
dialogue.zh: 是的，上車吧，還有四個空位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the stroller while we sit.
dialogue.zh: 坐下的同時扶好推車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam, keep your hands inside, please.
dialogue.zh: 山姆，手要放進車裡喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ride only takes five minutes.
dialogue.zh: 車程只要五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, I see the big entrance gate!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, aɪ si ðə bɪɡ ˈɛntrəns ɡeɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 看，我看到大大的入口了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here we are, let's hop off.
dialogue.zh: 到站了，我們下車吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, bags first, then the stroller.
dialogue.zh: 好，先拿袋子，再收推車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The line at the gate is long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪn æt ðə ɡeɪt ɪz lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 入口的隊伍好長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's join the family line instead.
dialogue.zh: 我們改排家庭隊伍吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About ten people are in front.
dialogue.zh: 前面大約有十個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It moves fast, we will be in soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt muvz fæst, wi wɪl bi ɪn sun./
dialogue.zh: 隊伍動得很快，一下子就輪到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is there a bag check?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼這裡要檢查包包？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps the zoo safe for everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kips ðə zu seɪf fɔr ˈɛvriˌwʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這樣園裡每個人才能安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they open every single bag?
dialogue.zh: 他們會把每個袋子都打開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a quick look inside, that's it.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə kwɪk lʊk ɪnˈsaɪd, ðæts ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 只看一眼裡面，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we bring food into the park?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi brɪŋ fud ˈɪntu ðə pɑrk?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能帶食物進園嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small snacks are fine, no glass bottles.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl snæks ər faɪn, noʊ ɡlæs ˈbɑtəlz./
dialogue.zh: 小點心可以，不能帶玻璃瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my water bottle okay to bring?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ ˈwɔtər ˈbɑtəl oʊˈkeɪ tu brɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 我的水壺可以帶進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, refills are free inside.
dialogue.zh: 可以，裡面能免費續水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show the guard your ticket, please.
dialogue.zh: 請把票給管理員看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says scanned, we are good to go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz skænd, wi ər ɡʊd tu ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 顯示已驗票，我們可以進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, we are finally inside!
dialogue.zh: 哇，我們終於進園啦！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, we need a park map.
dialogue.zh: 首先要拿一張園區地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can we get a free map?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn wi ɡɛt ə fri mæp?/
dialogue.zh: 哪裡可以拿到免費地圖？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a rack by the gift shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ræk baɪ ðə ɡɪft ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 禮品店旁邊就有地圖架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do maps come in other languages?
dialogue.zh: 地圖有其他語言的版本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take an English and a Chinese one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, teɪk ən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ænd ə tʃaɪˈniz wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 有，拿一份英文和一份中文的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have the map, please?
dialogue.zh: 可以把地圖給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, hold it flat.
dialogue.zh: 給你，平平地攤開拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The zoo is bigger than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə zu ɪz ˈbɪɡər ðæn aɪ θɔt./
dialogue.zh: 動物園比我想像中大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The map shows about ten animal zones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæp ʃoʊz əˈbaʊt tɛn ˈænəməl zoʊnz./
dialogue.zh: 地圖上大約有十個動物區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which zone should we see first?
dialogue.zh: 我們應該先看哪個區？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The savanna area is close and easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə səˈvænə ˈɛriə ɪz kloʊz ænd ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 草原動物區又近又好走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the giraffes are over there!
dialogue.zh: 看，長頸鹿在那邊！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, their necks are so long.
dialogue.zh: 哇，牠們的脖子好長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How tall is the tallest giraffe?
dialogue.zh: 最高的長頸鹿有多高？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sign says almost five meters.
dialogue.zh: 牌子上寫著將近五公尺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can it really be that tall?
dialogue.zh: 真的能有那麼高嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, babies are taller than me.
dialogue.zh: 真的，小只的都比我高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do giraffes eat all day?
dialogue.zh: 長頸鹿整天吃什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leaves from the very top branches.
dialogue.zh: 樹頂最上面的樹葉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, her tongue is purple!
dialogue.zh: 看，她的舌頭是紫色的！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She just wrapped it around a leaf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi dʒʌst ræpt ɪt əˈraʊnd ə lif./
dialogue.zh: 她剛用舌頭捲起了一片葉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do giraffes have spots?
dialogue.zh: 長頸鹿為什麼有斑點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The spots hide them in sunlight.
dialogue.zh: 斑點讓牠們在陽光下隱身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the giraffe feeding time over?
dialogue.zh: 長頸鹿的餵食時間結束了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it starts at two o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，兩點才開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can watch the keeper feed them.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən wɑtʃ ðə ˈkipər fid ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以看飼養員餵牠們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, the kids will love that.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，孩子們會很喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's walk to the elephant yard.
dialogue.zh: 我們走到大象區吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I already hear them calling!
dialogue.zh: 我已經聽到牠們的叫聲了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, that elephant is spraying water!
dialogue.zh: 看，那只大象在噴水！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her baby is jumping with joy.
dialogue.zh: 象寶寶開心地跳來跳去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do they call that long nose?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət du ðeɪ kɔl ðæt lɔŋ noʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 那個長長的鼻子叫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is called a strong trunk.
dialogue.zh: 那個叫做有力的長鼻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The trunk works like an arm.
dialogue.zh: 長鼻像手臂一樣靈活。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They can pick up logs with it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kən pɪk ʌp lɔɡz wɪð ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 牠們能用鼻捲起木頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do elephants eat daily?
dialogue.zh: 大象每天要吃多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lots of hay and greens, all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑts əv heɪ ænd ɡrinz, ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一大堆乾草和青菜，吃一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, she is eating whole leaves.
dialogue.zh: 看，她在大口吃葉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one got a big watermelon.
dialogue.zh: 那只分到了一顆大西瓜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are elephants friendly with each other?
dialogue.zh: 大象彼此很友善嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they hug with their trunks.
dialogue.zh: 是的，牠們用長鼻抱抱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their steps shake the ground, wow.
dialogue.zh: 哇，牠們的腳步把地面都震動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel it, step back a little.
dialogue.zh: 真的感覺到了，往後退一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's find the monkey island.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們去找猴子島。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see them swinging in the trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ðɛm ˈswɪŋɪŋ ɪn ðə triz./
dialogue.zh: 我看到牠們在樹間盪來盪去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That baby monkey is so funny.
dialogue.zh: 那只小猴子好搞笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is copying everything we do.
dialogue.zh: 它在模仿我們的一舉一動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that one scratching itself?
dialogue.zh: 那只為什麼在抓自己？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is how they clean themselves.
dialogue.zh: 那就是牠們清潔自己的方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, he grabbed a lady's hat!
dialogue.zh: 看，他搶了一位女士的帽子！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, now he is wearing it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, naʊ hi ɪz ˈwɛrɪŋ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 噢不，他現在戴在自己頭上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monkeys are smarter than I thought.
dialogue.zh: 猴子比我想像中聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too smart, they can open doors.
dialogue.zh: 聰明過頭了，牠們還會開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can monkeys really swing that far?
dialogue.zh: 猴子真的能盪那麼遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they jump from tree to tree.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ dʒʌmp frəm tri tu tri./
dialogue.zh: 能，牠們從這棵樹跳到那棵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam, do not feed the animals!
dialogue.zh: 山姆，不可以餵動物！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, the monkey wanted my cracker.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，是猴子想要我的餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why can we not feed them?
dialogue.zh: 我們為什麼不能餵牠們？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Human food can make them sick.
dialogue.zh: 人類的食物會讓牠們生病。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, there is a red sign.
dialogue.zh: 看，那裡有一塊紅色的牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says no feeding, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫著請勿餵食，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is feeding against the zoo rules?
dialogue.zh: 餵食是違反動物園規定的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keepers give them special meals.
dialogue.zh: 對，飼養員會給牠們專屬的餐食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But that monkey looked so hungry.
dialogue.zh: 但那只猴子看起來好餓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was just hoping for snacks.
dialogue.zh: 它只是想吃點免費的零食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A keeper will answer our questions.
dialogue.zh: 飼養員會回答我們的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can tell us what they eat.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kən tɛl ʌs wət ðeɪ it./
dialogue.zh: 他能告訴我們牠們吃什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you take our photo here?
dialogue.zh: 你能幫我們在這裡拍張照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, stand by the wooden fence.
dialogue.zh: 好，站到木柵欄旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I standing too near the edge?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ ˈstændɪŋ tu nɪr ði ɛdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 我站得太靠近邊緣了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step back one small step, please.
dialogue.zh: 請往後退一小步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smile and look up at the camera.
dialogue.phonetic: /smaɪl ænd lʊk ʌp æt ðə ˈkæmərə./
dialogue.zh: 笑一個，眼睛看鏡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam, do not make a silly face.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm, du nət meɪk ə ˈsɪli feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 山姆，不要做鬼臉啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more shot before we go.
dialogue.zh: 離開前再拍一張吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now copy the monkey, like this!
dialogue.zh: 現在學學猴子的樣子，就這樣！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun is right in our eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sʌn ɪz raɪt ɪn ˈaʊər aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 陽光正好直射我們的眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn a little this way, then smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ə ˈlɪtəl ðɪs weɪ, ðɛn smaɪl./
dialogue.zh: 往這邊轉一點，然後再笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that picture come out okay?
dialogue.zh: 那張照片拍得還可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the baby monkey is in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈbeɪbi ˈmʌŋki ɪz ɪn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，裡面還拍到了小猴子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's take one family selfie now.
dialogue.zh: 我們現在來拍一張全家自拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, count three, two, one, cheese.
dialogue.zh: 好，數三、二、一，茄子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This photo needs a big wave.
dialogue.zh: 這張照片要加一個揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, waving with my hand.
dialogue.zh: 像這樣，舉起手揮一揮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send the photos to my sister.
dialogue.zh: 把照片傳給我妹妹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will text her the whole set.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tɛkst hɜr ðə hoʊl sɛt./
dialogue.zh: 我把整組都傳給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last year's zoo trip rained all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst jɪrz zu trɪp reɪnd ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 去年逛動物園下了一整天的雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today is so much better, right?
dialogue.zh: 今天好太多了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the zebras near the bridge!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə ˈziːbrəz nɪr ðə brɪdʒ!/
dialogue.zh: 看，橋那邊的斑馬！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their stripes make them hard to count.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr straɪps meɪk ðɛm hɑrd tu kaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 牠們的花紋讓數不清幾隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Zebras look like black and white horses.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈziːbrəz lʊk laɪk blæk ənd waɪt ˈhɔrsəz./
dialogue.zh: 斑馬看起來像黑白條紋的馬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their stripes are different for each one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr straɪps ər ˈdɪfərənt fər itʃ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 每一隻的條紋都不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see the zebra's short mane?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju si ðə ˈziːbrəz ʃɔrt meɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 你有看到斑馬短短的鬃毛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it stands up like a brush.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt stændz ʌp laɪk ə brəʃ./
dialogue.zh: 有，豎起來像一把刷子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Giraffe or zebra, which does Sam like?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒəˈræf ər ˈziːbrə, wɪtʃ dʌz sæm laɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 長頸鹿和斑馬，山姆喜歡哪個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He loves giraffes best, for sure.
dialogue.zh: 他最愛的肯定是長頸鹿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we watch them a little longer?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi wɑtʃ ðɛm ə ˈlɪtəl ˈlɔŋɡər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以再久看一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but let's move in ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bət lɛts muv ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過我們十分鐘後就出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's watch the monkeys one more time.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts wɑtʃ ðə ˈmʌŋkiz wʌn mɔr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我們再去看一次猴子吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, one is catching its own tail!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, wʌn ɪz ˈkætʃɪŋ ɪts oʊn teɪl!/
dialogue.zh: 看，有一隻在抓自己的尾巴！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lily is laughing at the monkeys.
dialogue.zh: 莉莉被猴子逗得哈哈大笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are the funniest animals here.
dialogue.zh: 牠們是這裡最搞笑的動物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do monkeys sleep in the trees?
dialogue.zh: 猴子在樹上睡覺嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they build leaf beds at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ bɪld lif bɛdz æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 是的，牠們晚上用葉子鋪床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remember those big elephant ears?
dialogue.zh: 還記得大象那對大大的耳朵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They flap them to stay cool.
dialogue.zh: 牠們扇耳朵是為了降溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can ears really work like fans?
dialogue.zh: 耳朵真的能像扇子一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they cool down with each flap.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ kul daʊn wɪð itʃ flæp./
dialogue.zh: 對，每扇一下就涼快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, next we should see lions.
dialogue.zh: 好，接下來我們該去看獅子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan, but where are the lions?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd plæn, bət wɛr ər ðə ˈlaɪənz?/
dialogue.zh: 好計畫，可是獅子在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look for the lion sign on the map.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk fər ðə ˈlaɪən saɪn ɑn ðə mæp./
dialogue.zh: 找找地圖上獅子區的標誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it, the house is open, let's go.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt, ðə haʊs ɪz ˈoʊpən, lɛts ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 找到了，獅館開著，我們過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There they are, three sleeping lions!
dialogue.zh: 牠們在那裡，三隻睡著的獅子！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cubs use mom as a pillow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌbz juz mɑm æz ə ˈpɪloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 小獅子把媽媽當成枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do lions sleep this much daily?
dialogue.zh: 獅子每天都睡這麼多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost twenty hours a day.
dialogue.zh: 一天差不多要睡二十個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That looks so warm and soft.
dialogue.zh: 那看起來又好暖又好軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I would nap there too, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我也想在那睡一覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can lions really roar that loud?
dialogue.zh: 獅子的吼聲真的那麼大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, one just yawned and grumbled.
dialogue.zh: 聽，有一隻打了哈欠還低吼一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gosh, that sound is like thunder.
dialogue.zh: 天啊，那聲音像打雷一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My legs feel a little wobbly.
dialogue.zh: 我的腿都有點發抖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the tiger in all this?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪn ɔl ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 那老虎到底在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, behind the rocks in the shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /si, bɪˈhaɪnd ðə rɑks ɪn ðə ʃeɪd./
dialogue.zh: 看，在石頭後面的陰影裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its stripes are beautiful, but scary.
dialogue.zh: 牠的紋路很美，可是可怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tigers swim well, unlike most cats.
dialogue.zh: 老虎很會游泳，不像一般的貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big cats have soft paws, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過大貓的腳掌軟軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those paws can still run fast.
dialogue.zh: 那些腳掌跑起來還是很飛快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the tiger walking in circles?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə ˈtaɪɡər ˈwɔkɪŋ ɪn ˈsɜrkəlz?/
dialogue.zh: 老虎為什麼一直在繞圈走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keepers say that is normal here.
dialogue.zh: 飼養員說在這裡這很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it bored or just resting?
dialogue.zh: 它是無聊還是只是在休息？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is awake now, watch it stretch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz əˈweɪk naʊ, wɑtʃ ɪt strɛtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 牠現在醒了，看牠伸懶腰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's hurry, the pandas eat at noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ˈhɜri, ðə pænˈdəz it æt nun./
dialogue.zh: 快一點，大貓熊中午吃飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yay, I love watching pandas munch.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，我愛看貓熊大口吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, he sits up like a baby.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, hi sɪts ʌp laɪk ə ˈbeɪbi./
dialogue.zh: 看，他像寶寶一樣坐著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And holding bamboo like a sandwich.
dialogue.zh: 還抱著竹子，像在拿三明治。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do pandas eat only bamboo?
dialogue.zh: 貓熊只吃竹子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, many hours of bamboo each day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈmɛni ˈaʊərz ʌv bæmˈbu itʃ deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對，每天要好幾個小時吃竹子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much bamboo do they eat?
dialogue.zh: 牠們要吃多少竹子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up to forty pounds a day.
dialogue.zh: 一天最多吃四十磅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He peeled that stalk so fast.
dialogue.zh: 他剝那根竹竿剝得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crunch, crunch, you can hear it.
dialogue.zh: 卡滋卡滋，聽得到牠在嚼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The little panda is fat and round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪtəl pænˈdə ɪz fæt ənd raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 小貓熊又胖又圓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, round like a fuzzy basketball.
dialogue.zh: 對，像一顆毛絨絨的籃球。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are baby pandas tiny at birth?
dialogue.zh: 貓熊寶寶出生的時候很小嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one fits in your two hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn fɪts ɪn jʊr tu hænz./
dialogue.zh: 對，一隻只用兩手就捧得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a baby panda today?
dialogue.zh: 今天有小貓熊可以看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mei lives in the next house.
dialogue.zh: 美美住在隔壁的貓熊館。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What feeding events are still left?
dialogue.zh: 還剩下哪些餵食活動？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The seal talk is at two thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sil tɔk ɪz æt tu ˈθɜrti./
dialogue.zh: 海豹講解兩點半開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the penguin feeding time?
dialogue.zh: 企鵝餵食是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three o'clock, near the snowy pool.
dialogue.zh: 三點，在佈滿假雪的水池邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check the big board outside.
dialogue.zh: 我們去外面看那塊大看板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the schedule changes on weekends.
dialogue.zh: 好，週末的時間表會變動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the keeper talk easy to find?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈkipər tɔk ˈizi tu faɪnd?/
dialogue.zh: 飼養員的講解好找嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the flags to the big stage.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑloʊ ðə flæɡz tu ðə bɪɡ steɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 跟著旗子走就能到大舞台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is a keeper's talk about?
dialogue.zh: 飼養員的講解都在說什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They show food and tell fun facts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ʃoʊ fud ænd tɛl fʌn fækts./
dialogue.zh: 他們會展示食物，還會講趣事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which animal talk should we catch?
dialogue.zh: 我們該去聽哪一場動物講解？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The owl show is our best choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə aʊl ʃoʊ ɪz ˈaʊər bɛst tʃɔɪs./
dialogue.zh: 貓頭鷹那場是我們最好的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are owls awake during the day?
dialogue.zh: 貓頭鷹白天是清醒的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These owls stay awake for talks.
dialogue.zh: 這些貓頭鷹一有講解就醒著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Owl talks run just ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 貓頭鷹講解只持續十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can eat after all the talks.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən it ˈæftər ɔl ðə tɔks./
dialogue.zh: 聽完所有講解再去吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glad we caught the owl show.
dialogue.zh: 高興我們趕上了貓頭鷹那場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, the giraffe talk is next.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu, ðə dʒəˈræf tɔk ɪz nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，下一場是長頸鹿講解。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This line is for the giraffe talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs laɪn ɪz fər ðə dʒəˈræf tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 這個隊伍是排長頸鹿講解的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's wait here, the keeper is coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts weɪt hɪr, ðə ˈkipər ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們在這裡等，飼養員要來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you know giraffes sleep so little?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju noʊ dʒəˈræfs slip soʊ ˈlɪtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 你知道長頸鹿睡得非常少嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only minutes, even standing up.
dialogue.zh: 只睡幾分鐘，甚至是站著睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I hold Lily during the talk?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ hoʊld ˈlɪli ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə tɔk?/
dialogue.zh: 講解的時候我可以抱著莉莉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she sits best on my lap.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ʃi sɪts bɛst ɑn maɪ læp./
dialogue.zh: 可以，她坐在我腿上最乖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask the keeper a question after.
dialogue.zh: 結束後問飼養員一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, I have one ready.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我已經想好一個了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bird garden is just past that bridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɜrd ˈɡɑrdən ɪz dʒʌst pæst ðæt brɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 鳥園就在那座橋後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, blue birds everywhere in the trees!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, blu bɜrdz ˈɛvriˌwɛr ɪn ðə triz!/
dialogue.zh: 看，樹上到處都是藍色的鳥！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some birds fly free inside here.
dialogue.zh: 有些鳥在這裡是自由飛翔的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it safe to walk around them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt seɪf tu wɔk əˈraʊnd ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 在牠們旁邊走動安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, they are calm around people.
dialogue.zh: 安全，牠們見到人很淡定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one landed on a bench!
dialogue.zh: 這只剛落到長椅上！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A parrot just talked to me!
dialogue.zh: 有一隻鸚鵡剛剛跟我說話！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says hello to every kid.
dialogue.zh: 牠會跟每個小朋友說你好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can parrots really copy words?
dialogue.zh: 鸚鵡真的會學人說話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, some learn a hundred words.
dialogue.zh: 會，有的能學一百個詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask the parrot to say your name.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə ˈpɛrət tu seɪ jʊr neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 叫鸚鵡說說你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He said it! What a clever bird.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛd ɪt! wʌt ə ˈklɛvər bɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 牠真的說了！好聰明的鳥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hear that? A yellow bird sings.
dialogue.zh: 你聽，有隻黃鳥在唱歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Its wings are bright, like little fires.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts wɪŋz ər braɪt, laɪk ˈlɪtəl ˈfaɪərz./
dialogue.zh: 牠的翅膀亮亮的，像小小火焰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These birds eat fruit and seeds.
dialogue.zh: 這些鳥吃水果和種子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, that one hides a seed!
dialogue.zh: 看，那只把種子藏起來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there an owl house in this garden?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ən aʊl haʊs ɪn ðɪs ˈɡɑrdən?/
dialogue.zh: 這個鳥園裡有貓頭鷹館嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, near the quiet pine corner.
dialogue.zh: 有，在安靜的松樹角那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is cool and dark in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz kul ænd dɑrk ɪn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡面又涼又暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The birds rest in the shade too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɜrdz rɛst ɪn ðə ʃeɪd tu./
dialogue.zh: 鳥兒也會在陰影中休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that parrot wearing a toy?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðæt ˈpɛrət ˈwɛrɪŋ ə tɔɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 那只鸚鵡為什麼掛著玩具？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Parrots play with bells and ropes.
dialogue.zh: 鸚鵡喜歡玩鈴噹和繩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do birds have soft feathers?
dialogue.zh: 鳥的羽毛是軟軟的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they keep them clean and smooth.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ kip ðɛm klin ænd smuð./
dialogue.zh: 對，牠們會保持羽毛乾淨平滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam, please stay away from the fence.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm, pliz steɪ əˈweɪ frʌm ðə fɛns./
dialogue.zh: 山姆，請離柵欄遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But I want to touch the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət aɪ wɑnt tu tʌtʃ ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 可是我想摸摸那道圍牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No touching, some animals can bite.
dialogue.zh: 不能碰，有些動物會咬人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even through the wire, is that true?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən θru ðə ˈwaɪər, ɪz ðæt tru?/
dialogue.zh: 就算隔著鐵絲網也會嗎？真的假的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This fence is high for a reason.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs fɛns ɪz haɪ fər ə ˈrizən./
dialogue.zh: 這道柵欄築這麼高是有原因的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will stand on the mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ wɪl stænd ɑn ðə mæt./
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我會站在黃線墊上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look down, there is a glass window.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk daʊn, ðɛr ɪz ə ɡlæs ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 往下看，有一塊玻璃窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can see a tiger foot!
dialogue.zh: 我看到老虎的腳掌了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The viewing glass is thick and safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈvjuɪŋ ɡlæs ɪz θɪk ænd seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 這塊觀賞玻璃又厚又安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lily, wave at the tiger, please.
dialogue.zh: 莉莉，跟老虎揮揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not tap the glass, it scares them.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt tæp ðə ɡlæs, ɪt skɛrz ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 不要敲玻璃，那會嚇到牠們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, we will just look quietly.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我們只用眼睛乖乖看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am so hungry right now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在真的好餓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next, we need a real lunch.
dialogue.zh: 接下來得正經吃頓午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet are so sore now.
dialogue.zh: 我的腳現在走好痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, let's find a shaded bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu, lɛts faɪnd ə ˈʃeɪdɪd bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，找個有陰涼的椅子吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, the sun is strong today.
dialogue.zh: 唉，今天的太陽好曬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That big tree has nice shade.
dialogue.zh: 那棵大樹下的陰涼很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you bring the picnic blanket?
dialogue.zh: 你有帶野餐墊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is under the stroller.
dialogue.zh: 有，在推車下面的置物架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lunch first or a quick snack?
dialogue.zh: 先吃午餐還是先墊點心？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snacks first, the kids are hungry.
dialogue.zh: 先吃點心，孩子們都餓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our sandwiches taste better outside.
dialogue.zh: 三明治在戶外吃特別美味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the juice is ice cold!
dialogue.zh: 果汁還是冰冰涼涼的！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These crackers make my hands salty.
dialogue.zh: 餅乾吃得我滿手都是鹽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, use a wet wipe after.
dialogue.zh: 來，吃完用張濕紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a café across the lake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə kæˈfeɪ əˈkrɔs ðə leɪk./
dialogue.zh: 湖對面有一家咖啡廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too far, let's just eat here.
dialogue.zh: 太遠了，我們就在這吃吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we refill the water cups?
dialogue.zh: 水杯可以再裝水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a fountain near the farm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈfaʊntən nɪr ðə fɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 牧場那邊有飲水噴泉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the kids' farm is open again!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə kɪdz fɑrm ɪz ˈoʊpən əˈɡɛn!/
dialogue.zh: 看，兒童牧場又開門了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yay, the goats! Let's go there.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，山羊！我們過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They sell farm feed at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ sɛl fɑrm fid æt ðə ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 門口在賣餵動物的飼料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small cup is enough.
dialogue.zh: 對，買一小杯就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only this feed, nothing from our bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðɪs fid, ˈnʌθɪŋ frʌm ˈaʊər bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 只能用這飼料，不能拿自己的食物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the sign says that too.
dialogue.zh: 對，牌子上也這麼寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A goat just sniffed my shoe.
dialogue.zh: 有只山羊剛在聞我的鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, it wants your salty snacks!
dialogue.zh: 哈，牠想偷你的鹹零食！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use both hands to hold the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz boʊθ hænz tu hoʊld ðə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 用兩手捧好這個飼料杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One ate from my hand already!
dialogue.zh: 有一隻已經從我手上吃了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are baby goats called kids?
dialogue.zh: 小山羊是不是也叫小孩？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that tiny one is a kid.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt ˈtaɪni wʌn ɪz ə kɪd./
dialogue.zh: 對，那只小小的就是山羊寶寶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its horns are so small and soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts hɔrns ər soʊ smɔl ænd sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 牠的角又小又軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mother is licking her baby.
dialogue.zh: 山羊媽媽正在舔牠的寶寶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we gently pet the sheep?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以輕輕摸綿羊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, stroke from head to tail.
dialogue.zh: 可以，從頭到尾順著摸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This wool feels warmer than my coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʊl filz ˈwɔrmər ðæn maɪ koʊt./
dialogue.zh: 這羊毛比我的外套還溫暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Farmers cut it to make sweaters.
dialogue.zh: 農夫剪下來做毛衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This rabbit sits still in my lap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈræbɪt sɪts stɪl ɪn maɪ læp./
dialogue.zh: 這只兔子在我腿上很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, it may jump away soon.
dialogue.zh: 小心點，牠一下可能就跳走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to wash our hands here.
dialogue.zh: 我們在這裡把手洗乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little sink line is moving fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪtəl sɪŋk laɪn ɪz ˈmuvɪŋ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 小洗手台那邊的隊伍動很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the ducks followed us!
dialogue.zh: 看，鴨子跟著我們耶！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They hope we drop them some food.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ hoʊp wi drɑp ðɛm səm fud./
dialogue.zh: 牠們盼我們掉點食物給牠們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's stop by the gift shop now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts stɑp baɪ ðə ɡɪft ʃɑp naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們去禮品店逛一下吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we need a trip souvenir.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們該買個紀念品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, this shop is full of plush toys.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, ðɪs ʃɑp ɪz fʊl ʌv plʌʃ tɔɪz./
dialogue.zh: 哇，這間店全是毛絨玩具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lily already found a panda bear!
dialogue.zh: 莉莉已經找到一隻貓熊娃娃！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the small giraffe?
dialogue.zh: 小長頸鹿玩偶多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve dollars, the big one is more.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈdɑlərz, ðə bɪɡ wʌn ɪz mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 十二美元，大的那種更貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which animal should Sam get today?
dialogue.zh: 山姆今天該選哪只動物？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wants the roaring lion doll.
dialogue.zh: 他想要那會吼的獅子娃娃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or the toy snake, which one wins?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr ðə tɔɪ sneɪk, wɪtʃ wʌn wɪnz?/
dialogue.zh: 還是玩具蛇？哪一個會贏？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The snake is funny, but soft wins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sneɪk ɪz ˈfʌni, bət sɔft wɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 蛇很搞笑，不過還是軟的贏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the lion rides home with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ðə ˈlaɪən raɪdz hoʊm wɪð ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 好啦，獅子娃娃陪我們坐車回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it fits beside him in the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt fɪts bɪˈsaɪd hɪm ɪn ðə sit./
dialogue.zh: 可以，能放在他座位旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they have zoo caps here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡有動物園的帽子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, green caps with a tiger patch.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɡrin kæps wɪð ə ˈtaɪɡər pætʃ./
dialogue.zh: 有，帶老虎布章的綠帽子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cap for you, one for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kæp fər ju, wʌn fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 一頂給你，一頂給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a key chain for grandma.
dialogue.zh: 再幫奶奶買個鑰匙圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This puzzle shows all the animals.
dialogue.zh: 這個拼圖上有全部動物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is big, maybe too big.
dialogue.zh: 好大，可能大到帶不回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's just buy the small things.
dialogue.zh: 我們只買小東西就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, our arms are full already.
dialogue.zh: 對啊，我們兩手都拿滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we pay by phone at this counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi peɪ baɪ foʊn æt ðɪs ˈkaʊntər?/
dialogue.zh: 這個櫃台可以用手機付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just tap at the register.
dialogue.zh: 可以，在收銀台拍一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam is holding his lion tight.
dialogue.zh: 山姆緊緊抱著他的獅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He smiles like he found treasure.
dialogue.zh: 他笑得像尋到寶一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lily fell near the mirror inside.
dialogue.zh: 莉莉在裡面的鏡子旁跌倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a small bump, no real tears.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə smɔl bʌmp, noʊ rɪl tɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 只是輕輕撞了一下，沒哭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is Sam? He was just here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz sæm? hi wʌz dʒʌst hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 山姆呢？他明明就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He stood by the mirror just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi stʊd baɪ ðə ˈmɪrər dʒʌst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 他剛剛還站在鏡子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go ask the guard, I will look here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ æsk ðə ɡɑrd, aɪ wɪl lʊk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 你去請管理員幫忙，我在這附近找。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The guard will use the loudspeaker.
dialogue.zh: 管理員會用廣播系統。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, that is the lost-child call.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd, ðæt ɪz ðə lɔst tʃaɪd kɔl./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那是尋找小孩的公告。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They found him by the giraffe snack bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ faʊnd hɪm baɪ ðə dʒəˈræf snæk bɑr./
dialogue.zh: 他們在長頸鹿點心亭找到他了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's stay right here, not far.
dialogue.zh: 我們就在這裡等，別走遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here he comes, no scolding today.
dialogue.zh: 他回來了，今天不罵他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold his hand when we walk.
dialogue.zh: 走路的時候要牽著他。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and we count heads often.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們也要常數人數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was our one scare today.
dialogue.zh: 今天受驚的就只有這一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now let's go and catch the shuttle.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɛts ɡoʊ ænd kætʃ ðə ˈʃʌtl./
dialogue.zh: 現在去搭擺渡車吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Man, the lot feels far from here.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæn, ðə lɑt filz fɑr frʌm hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 天，停車場感覺好遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shuttle will bring us right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈʃʌtl wɪl brɪŋ ʌs raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 擺渡車會直接把我們送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No seats left, but one more comes.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ sits lɛft, bət wʌn mɔr kʌmz./
dialogue.zh: 沒有位子，不過還有一班要來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can wait at the shady stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən weɪt æt ðə ˈʃeɪdi stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在陰涼的站牌等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our car is almost in view.
dialogue.zh: 我們的車已經看得到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, stroller first into the trunk.
dialogue.zh: 好，先把推車摺進後車廂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have to stop anywhere?
dialogue.zh: 中途還需要停靠什麼地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just gas, and then go home.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, dʒʌst ɡæs, ænd ðɛn ɡoʊ hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 不用，加個油就直接回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is a long day at the zoo.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə lɔŋ deɪ æt ðə zu./
dialogue.zh: 今天在動物園待了好久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But we saw so many animals today.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət wi sɔ soʊ ˈmɛni ˈænəməlz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 但我們今天看到好多動物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same plan for the next trip?
dialogue.zh: 下一次也照這個計畫來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will come back next month.
dialogue.zh: 下個月我們再回來玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, Sam is already snoring.
dialogue.zh: 你聽，山姆已經在打呼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fast asleep, hugging his lion.
dialogue.zh: 抱著獅子娃娃緊緊地睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car seat rocks him to sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑr sit rɑks hɪm tu slip./
dialogue.zh: 安全座椅搖啊搖就把他哄睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lily is closing her eyes too.
dialogue.zh: 莉莉的眼睛也快閉上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At last, a quiet drive home.
dialogue.zh: 終於，可以安靜地開車回家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, we can look at today's photos.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, wi kən lʊk æt təˈdeɪz ˈfoʊtoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 正好，我們可以回味今天的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need anything for next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ˈɛniθɪŋ fər nɛkst taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 下次來之前還需要準備什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only more snacks and good shoes.
dialogue.zh: 只要多帶點心、穿好走的鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today's zoo trip was the best.
dialogue.zh: 今天的動物園之旅最棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, dream of pandas tonight.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，今晚就夢見貓熊吧。
